title: Mallard Duck Movement
text:
Lake Constance lies where Germany, Switzerland, and Austria meet. This site explores GPS tracking data from 52 individual mallard ducks, collected across the 2007–2017 study period.
Most ducks stayed close to the lake, while a few traveled several hundred kilometers northeast toward Poland and Hungary. Flight activity peaked in July and August, after the breeding season. Visit the Map and Seasons pages in the navbar to explore the routes and seasonal flight patterns.
